annotations.title: Cue sheet: writers, splits, ISRC, publisher

description: The clearance data a broadcaster or PRO filing needs for one cue: every credited writer with role, society and IPI, every publisher with its share, the ISRC and the album. A field missing from the response is not on file in the catalogue; info@songstoyoureyes.com handles gaps. Licensing is arranged with the Songs To Your Eyes team, outside these tools.
